tasks.label: Build Fuzion (Debug)
tasks.command: $vswhere = Join-Path '${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}' 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools with MSBuild.' }; & $msbuild 'Fuzion Dock.sln' /restore /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform='Any CPU' /nologo /m

tasks.label: Build Fuzion (Release)
tasks.command: $vswhere = Join-Path '${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}' 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools with MSBuild.' }; & $msbuild 'Fuzion Dock.sln' /restore /t:Build /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform='Any CPU' /nologo /m

tasks.label: Build Store Package (MSIX)
tasks.detail: Produces FuzionPackaging/AppPackages/*.msixupload for Partner Center submission.
tasks.command: $vswhere = Join-Path '${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}' 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { throw 'MSBuild.exe not found. Install Visual Studio 2022 or Build Tools with MSBuild.' }; & $msbuild 'FuzionPackaging\FuzionPackaging.wapproj' /restore /t:Build /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64 /p:AppxPackageSigningEnabled=false /p:UapAppxPackageBuildMode=StoreUpload /nologo /m; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Get-ChildItem 'FuzionPackaging\AppPackages\*.msixupload' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "`nStore upload package: $($_.FullName)" } }

tasks.label: Run Fuzion
tasks.command: $exe = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'FuzionDock\bin\Debug\Fuzion.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { throw 'Build output not found. Run the build task first.' }; Start-Process -FilePath $exe

tasks.label: Stop Fuzion
tasks.command: $stopped = $false; Get-Process Fuzion -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force; $stopped = $true }; if ($stopped) { 'Stopped Fuzion' } else { 'Fuzion was not running' }
